decisions.reason: The large bulk container sits close to the core range and has its own web page, so the firm is visibly committed to it. Tooling and moulds are already sunk, and any early weakness after the 2024 launch can still be put down to ramp-up.

The valve builds on the established bulk-container offer and has its own page, so the firm has publicly committed to it. As an add-on component it costs little to keep, while the development investment is already spent.

The take-back service fits the firm's announced move toward circular, service-based packaging, which gives management strong reason to justify and persist with it. It is only mentioned on the website and needed less sunk investment, so the risk of dropping it is somewhat higher than for the other two.
